updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-14 1637

Online: ping display above the timer, 12 heavy/no-wall stages skipped online, replays of online matches now record properly. Replays show both players' stick inputs. Smaller training stick display.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-14 1937
updates.notes: Replays: player names show in replays of online matches, both players' stick inputs are shown while watching, replays older than 30 days are deleted automatically (put 'keep' in a file name to keep it). Ping no longer shows during replays. Fixed the stage select being skipped after picking modes in Training. Wall bounce update.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-16 1436
updates.notes: Hyper Drive mode (D), Combo Breaker cooldown style + fixes, vnix 2.7.3 text effects, air Guard Push fix + EOH effect option, BBTag Guard Push, Meta World 2 stocks/8s in team modes, Heat Drive 8s + 10s cooldown, snapback fix, Danger sound, SF4/SFV custom-state fixes, character fixes.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-16 1524
updates.notes: Infinity Stones: use your stone with HP+HK (was LP+LK), same as the other modes. Normal Vegeta Z2: fixed him turning into a ki blast and floating off screen.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-16 1531
updates.notes: Infinity Stones: use your stone with HP+HK (was LP+LK), same as the other modes. Normal Vegeta Z2: fixed him turning into a ki blast and floating off screen.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-16 1543
updates.notes: No items or Meta World during the Sudden Death round.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-17 2223
updates.notes: LB/LT swap fix (checks every second now), X-Factor no longer carries over between rounds/matches, Baroque vs Drive Impact input fix, Combo Breaker LP+MP+HP / Counter Breaker LK+MK+HK + new Meter style (2000 power), Heat Drive 15 s + H icon refill + Wild Counter any time, Hyper Drive Drive Cancel (half gauge) + faster gauge on bigger combos + Wild Counter, burnout blocks tag/assist/snap/TAC/VC/DHC/air dash/parry/push guard/guard dash cancel/combo breaker, select screen profile load fix, Heavy D palette fix, 8-way air dash tilt.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-17 2238
updates.notes: Hyper Drive: cancelling a special into the same special now costs gauge/timer (was free and endless, e.g. Heavy D qcf+y).

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-17 2312
updates.notes: Heat Drive: 8-way air dash removed, no air dash while Heat Drive is on, heavier super jump in Heat Drive. Hyper Drive: cancel into a super costs power only while the gauge builds; in Hyper Drive super cancels only in the last 2 seconds.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-18 0024
updates.notes: CVS online: chain combos, super jump and air dash are off. Hyper Drive gauge builds faster (specials 90, supers 120 per hit). Zero and Marco changes.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-18 1349
updates.notes: Items: Bomb, Heart, Frag Stone, Phoenix Elixir and Dispel Knife removed; Painkiller / Crit Berry / Soul Pearl / Blood Crystal last 3 hits; Hammer and Phase Cap 4 s; Shield 125. Animation changes for CVS and MVC characters.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-19 1620
updates.notes: vnix 2.7.3 ports: Mega Burst (Baroque/Heat Drive/Infinity Stones/Hyper Drive teams), Just Defend, Ultra Combo, Dual Assault (D,DB,B+LB, combos in), revamped Dramatic Dodge (MP+HK), blood effects. X-Factor 'Under 50% Life' option. Combo Breaker Meter style 30 s cooldown; Counter Breaker 2000 power for Mega Burst teams. No charging in burnout. VS screen names + mode letters. Online: Netplay Settings + Profile menus, hold Back 2 s to leave a match, only First Attack/Danger text, last-match ping on select/VS. CVS character updates.

updates.notes: vnix 2.7.3 ports: Mega Burst (Baroque/Heat Drive/Infinity Stones/Hyper Drive teams), Just Defend, Ultra Combo, Dual Assault (D,DB,B+LB, combos in), revamped Dramatic Dodge (MP+HK), blood effects. X-Factor 'Under 50% Life' option. Combo Breaker Meter style 30 s cooldown; Counter Breaker 2000 power for Mega Burst teams. No charging in burnout. VS screen names + mode letters. updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-19 2023
updates.notes: New engine (bgpad30): hold Back on a controller for 2 seconds to leave an online match (same as Esc); co-op shows P3/P4 profile names on their lifebars. Ping removed from the select/VS screens (it only showed the last match's number).

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-19 2204
updates.notes: Online: Back/B cancels Host/Join waiting; holding Back leaves the select screen online; 'LEAVING' text when holding Back online. Win camera stays on the winner every round (no panning up on air KOs). Extra Settings: Blood submenu (from 50%/always, splat sound, colour) and Ultra Combo submenu (hits needed, opponent life). No super jump in burnout. X-Factor no longer fires on Drive Impact (Forward + HP+HK). Sudden Death logs every KO.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-19 2228
updates.notes: Burnout locks Dramatic Dodge, Hyper Drive special cancels and Last Stand too. Training input display sits smaller above the Hyper Drive gauge for Hyper Drive teams.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-20 0949
updates.notes: LB/LT fix: profiles can no longer be saved or loaded with LB and LT backwards (TagWars layout LT = VC/Snap, LB = Tag/Assist is enforced on save and load).

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-20 0957
updates.notes: Engine bgpad31: hold Back on a controller for 2 seconds to leave a replay (same as Esc).

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-20 1008
